asset_ownership_interpretation: Current reviewed Revolut staking materials state that Revolut continues holding staked cryptoassets on the user's behalf and that the user remains beneficial owner. CYA records this as customer-owned beneficial-interest treatment for the reviewed staking product while preserving that legal-title, safeguarding, contracting-entity and insolvency treatment may differ by jurisdiction and terms version.
notes: Customer-owned reflects express beneficial-ownership language in current first-party staking terms and product material. It is not a universal conclusion that the customer holds legal title, that assets are legally segregated, or that principal or insolvency protection applies across all Revolut entities and jurisdictions.
